summary_en: 11,556 common shares (0.33% of shares outstanding) to be cancelled effective 2026-10-13. Represents all treasury stock held as of 2026-07-21. Post-cancellation issued share count: 3,498,444. Cancellation is conditional on shareholder approval of a stock consolidation (effective 2026-10-14) at the extraordinary general meeting scheduled 2026-09-16.
title_en: Notice of Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Ryomo Systems announced on 2026-08-04 that its board of directors has resolved to cancel 11,556 common shares held in treasury under Company Law article 178. The shares to be cancelled represent all treasury stock held as of 2026-07-21 and constitute 0.33% of shares outstanding prior to cancellation. The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on 2026-10-13. Following cancellation, the company's issued share count will decrease to 3,498,444 shares. The cancellation is conditional on shareholder approval of a stock consolidation scheduled to take effect 2026-10-14, with approval expected from the extraordinary general meeting set for 2026-09-16.
